sam (Partnerships): Heads-up: AuroraCloud requested listing in ms-orchid-3 marketplace. They want 20 RTX9000-equivalent GPUs reserved, private VPC option, BYOK KMS, and 2 static egress IPs. Target GA: 2026-06-01.

tokyo (AuroraCloud): Correct. Baseline for GA is 12 reserved non-preempt GPUs, burst to 20. Low-latency inference for EU customers only initially.

lee (Cloud Ops): Need exact SKU IDs, non-preempt flag, and key ARN for KMS. Also confirm whether they need cross-account role for image pulls.

tokyo (AuroraCloud): SKU: ["RTX9000_48GB_v1"] non-preempt only. We'll provide KMS ARN and IAM trust policy. Image pulls via partner-managed registry, will request cross-account role.

sam (Partnerships): Add marketplace tile needs: dedicated capacity toggle, private VPC checkbox, and note "limited initial capacity" until pool grows.

jas (Solutions): Ops suggestion: canary with 2 tenants, reserve 8 GPUs initially. Monitor p95 latency, 5xx rate, and GPU mem OOMs. Plan fallback to ms-orchid-2-hosted if allocations fail.

anika (Legal): Draft wording: "Reserved capacity is subject to provider region availability; automatic fallback to hosted variants may occur. See Redwood Dedicated terms." Partner must not claim independent SLA beyond our Dedicated terms.

lee (Cloud Ops): Opening ticket CP-4999, attaching entitlement template. Require partner to submit entitlement JSON with region, sku_ids, reserved_count, burst_capacity, kms_arn, vpc_required, static_ips. Example:
```
{
  "region": "ms-orchid-3",
  "sku_ids": ["RTX9000_48GB_v1"],
  "reserved_count": 12,
  "burst_capacity": 20,
  "kms_arn": "arn:aws:kms:...:key/abcd",
  "vpc_required": true,
  "static_ips": 2
}
```

ticket-bot: CP-4999 created by lee at 1767771300 1 link: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/CP-4999

lee (Cloud Ops): Provider preliminary response: 10/12 non-preempt GPUs available; final pool decision ETA ~24h. If shortfall persists, we'll propose phased GA and increased burst billing until pool scaled.

tokyo (AuroraCloud): 10 is tight but acceptable for canary. We'll prepare GA messaging that marks capacity as "limited" until fully provisioned.

sam (Partnerships): Action items:
- @tokyo: provide entitlement JSON, KMS ARN, IAM trust policy, and marketplace assets (tile + docs) by EOD.
- @lee: track CP-4999 and propose fallback routing rule (2 allocation failures -> ms-orchid-2-hosted).
- @jas: draft canary runbook (metrics + rollback triggers).
- @anika: finalize short entitlement blurb for the tile.

lee (Cloud Ops): Noted. Updating CP-4999 with fallback policy and static IP request. Final update expected 1767771500.

sam (Partnerships): Thanks all. Will coordinate marketing hold until we confirm full capacity. Reopening thread when CP-4999 moves to approved.

ticket-bot: CP-4999 status updated: pending provider confirmation at 1767771500."
